'''Illo Vandin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who resided on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Rising up from humble beginnings on [[Giju/Legends|Giju]], Illo Vandin traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] as part of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] crew for much of his formative years. Stranded on Ord Mantell, Vandin made a name for himself on the gambling circuit and became incredibly wealthy. Financially backing up-and-coming gamblers on occasion, Vandin was fond of taking young professionals under his tutelage and serving as their manager. In addition, Vandin operated many smaller casinos in [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] and abroad, bringing in additional revenue to his already sizable estate. Secretly, Vandin had dealings that circumvented the law. He established and ran operations in [[racketeering]], [[loan shark]]ing, and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] which cemented his position in the elite class of the planet. Residing in the [[Jewel District]] of Worlport, Vandin owned a [[Illo Vandin's villa|modestly-sized villa]] with interior walls that were floor-to-ceiling [[Aquarium/Legends|aquariums]] holding exotic marine life. The estate was patrolled by guardsmen to act as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] and protect his wealth. Despite this, Vandin still carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] on his person.
